brief:
Prediction markets are registering movement in the odds surrounding Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, according to Ma'an Wire. The shifts reflect changing assessments of their respective political and legal fortunes, though specific market indicators and the direction of movement were not detailed.

The markets typically aggregate investor sentiment on political developments and judicial proceedings. Such platforms have tracked expectations around Israeli leadership in the past, though their predictive accuracy remains subject to volatility and manipulation risks inherent in small-scale betting markets.

title: Prediction markets shift odds on Netanyahu and Eisenkot outcomes
